name: PIA WireGuard (unofficial)
author: JamesRBlack
description: Unofficial Private Internet Access WireGuard widget: status, killswitch, server list with search and flags. Needs the system part from the repo's install.sh. Not affiliated with Private Internet Access.

barWidget.description: Left click: status, on/off and a searchable server list. Right click: toggle the VPN. Middle click: refresh. Requires install.sh from the repo.
